summary: Pinned Writer indent branch is implemented at matching text shell, edit shell and document formatting boundaries for the supported browser slice.
findings: Document-default tab distance, selected text nodes, list levels, undo, modifier and page-body width guard have focused assertions; native table frames and multiple selection rings remain outside the browser slice.
evidence_refs: npm run verify: 482 office tests, 98 inventory tests, 14 browser tests, 100% coverage
residual_risks: Frame width uses the browser page body because native table and column frames are not implemented.
